### Oahu's annual winter competition is here!

---

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:50 AM.

---

**This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to [Kapiʻolani Medical Center for Women & Children](https://www.hawaiipacifichealth.org/locations/kapiolani/). See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHawaii2027#83173-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.**
